headline: IMFA issues postal ballot notice to appoint Partha Satpathy as independent director
hook: New independent director proposed at IMFA
summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has notified the stock exchanges about a postal ballot. Shareholders will vote on a special resolution to appoint Mr Partha Satpathy as an Independent Director of the company. Postal ballots allow shareholders to vote remotely without attending a physical general meeting. This is a routine corporate governance filing for the listed ferroalloys manufacturer.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate financial impact for retail shareholders.

headline: Geojit identifies three stocks with bullish technical trends
hook: Three stocks showing bullish technical patterns
summary: Anand James of Geojit Investments has issued a buy recommendation for Happiest Minds, IMFA, and Brigade Enterprises. These stocks were selected based on positive momentum observed on their technical charts. The recommendations are intended for short-term trading strategies. Retail investors should note that technical calls are based on price action and do not reflect fundamental changes in company performance.
why_it_matters: Potential short-term price momentum for these specific stocks
